r_function: ppcor::pcor(X) / ppcor::pcor.test(x, y, Z) (unweighted, asserted); corpcor::cor2pcor(R) on the (weighted) correlation
note: controls empty = control for every other member (precision matrix). A named control list gives each member pair controlled for exactly those fields (the 'partial' matrix covers members only). statistic = r*sqrt((n-2-gp)/(1-r^2)), p = 2*pt(-|t|, n-2-gp) with n = n_star (sum(w) frequency, Kish n_eff probability, min pair n pairwise), as ppcor does. Diagonals of statistic / p_value are null.
